Title: Dinner Is Swerved/Bottled Up Emotions
Writer: Irving Belateche, Robert Zappia, Jim Praytor
Actors: Jason Alexander, Grey Griffin, Simon Helberg
Plot: When Ginger and Rick leave the house for a trip, Tom and Jerry plan to serve their girlfriends dinner, but things get competitive with them. Jerry gets affected by one of Dr. Bigby's experiments.
